engine.description: Contract version. A floating major: every v1 engine accepts every v1 manifest.

name.description: Package identity and ownership namespace. Vendored artifacts are prefixed with it.

version.description: Defaults to the version of the package.json beside the manifest.

skills.description: Directory of <name>/SKILL.md folders, relative to the manifest.

agents.description: Directory of <name>.md subagent definitions, relative to the manifest.

commands.description: Directory of <name>.md slash commands, relative to the manifest.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to register with each harness, keyed by server name.

command.description: The executable to run. {{version}} and {{name}} are filled in.

args.description: Arguments. {{version}} and {{name}} are filled in, e.g. "my-server@{{version}}".

env.description: Literal environment values the package sets. Never put a secret here.

envPassthrough.description: Names of variables the server reads from the user's own environment. Harnesses that do not hand a server the whole environment are told to let these through; an unset one may arrive as an empty string.

startupTimeoutSec.description: How long a harness should wait for the server to start, where it lets a package say.

toolTimeoutSec.description: How long a harness should wait for one tool call, where it lets a package say.

headers.description: Request headers. A value may reference a variable from the user's environment as {{env:NAME}}, e.g. "Bearer {{env:ACME_TOKEN}}". Never put a credential here.

startupTimeoutSec.description: How long a harness should wait for the server to start, where it lets a package say.

toolTimeoutSec.description: How long a harness should wait for one tool call, where it lets a package say.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks to register with each harness, keyed by a name of your choosing.

matcher.description: For tool events, the canonical tool names the hook applies to (Bash, Edit, Write, ...). Omit for every tool.

command.description: The shell command to run. {{hooks_dir}} is where the package's hook files are installed.

hooksDir.description: Directory of files the hook commands run, installed once and shared by every harness.

environment.description: Environment variables the package reads: what each is for and whether it is required. Used to tell the user what to set; values are never read or stored.

required.description: The package does not work without it. The installer says so when it is not set.

namespace.description: How vendored artifact names avoid colliding with the user's own. "prefix" installs skill "setup" of package "notarize" as "notarize-setup".

onboardingSkill.description: A skill to offer straight after installing. Must name a skill the package has.

scopes.description: Where the package may be installed: "local" (one repository), "user" (every project). Default both.

harnesses.description: Restrict the package to these harness ids. Omit to allow every harness the engine knows.

listing.description: Marketplace metadata, read only by `agentdist pack`.

pack.description: Native plugin formats to generate with `agentdist pack`, keyed by target id (claude-plugin, codex-plugin, agent-plugin, dsh-bundle), each with its own options.
